# AlloCinéma

> France's leading entertainment guide for films, TV series, and cinema experiences with comprehensive databases, showtimes, and exclusive video content.

AlloCinéma provides French audiences with an extensive film and television database featuring 4,500+ TV series, curated rankings of top films, real-time box office data, cinema showtimes across France, and original video content. The platform covers streaming services like Netflix and Disney+, animation classics from Disney and Pixar, and the latest entertainment news.

## Key Topics

- French cinema
- Film rankings
- TV series database
- Cinema showtimes
- Box office France
- Upcoming releases
- Disney animation
- Pixar films
- Movie trailers
- Streaming content
- Documentary films
- Family entertainment
- Film reviews
- Entertainment news
- Cinema releases

## Films & Rankings

- [Best Films of All Time](https://www.allocine.fr/film/meilleurs): Ranked database of 300 best films of all time with filtering and recommendations
- [Best Disney Animation Films](https://www.allocine.fr/tag-6035/films): Curated ranking of best Disney animated films including classics like The Lion King
- [Best Pixar Films](https://www.allocine.fr/tag-1141/films): Top-ranked Pixar animated films including Coco and other studio masterpieces
- [Best Documentaries](https://www.allocine.fr/film/meilleurs/documentaires): Top 300 documentary rankings filtered by year, country, and audience ratings

## Cinema & Showtimes

- [French Cinema Theaters](https://www.allocine.fr/salle): French cinema theater finder with showtimes and schedules across major cities
- [Weekly Cinema Releases](https://www.allocine.fr/film/agenda): Weekly cinema release schedule showing upcoming film releases and premiere dates
- [Box Office France](https://www.allocine.fr/boxoffice/france): Weekly French box office rankings tracking ticket sales and current cinema hits
- [Preview Screenings](https://www.allocine.fr/film/avantpremieres): Preview screenings directory listing 133 films shown across France before release

## TV Series & Video Content

- [TV Series Directory](https://www.allocine.fr/series): Comprehensive TV series directory with 4,500+ show files and episode summaries
- [Movie & Series Trailers](https://www.allocine.fr/trailer): Complete video library of movie trailers and TV series teasers for upcoming releases
- [AlloCinéma Original Videos](https://www.allocine.fr/video): AlloCinéma original video content and shows featuring movie analysis and entertainment

## News & Features

- [Entertainment News](https://www.allocine.fr/news): Latest entertainment news covering film releases, TV updates, and celebrity announcements
- [In-Depth Dossiers](https://www.allocine.fr/dossiers): In-depth special features on cinema and TV series with reviews and behind-the-scenes content

## Family & Children

- [Films for Children in Cinemas](https://www.allocine.fr/film/enfants/aucinema): Curated selection of 74 child-friendly films currently in French cinemas
